Bill.BriefDescription: Relating to ensuring the safety of milk and dairy products.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ensuring the safety of milk and dairy products;and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the protection ofthe public from the sale or distribution of hazardous milk and dairyproducts requires strong enforcement mechanisms available to regulatoryagencies. The legislature must ensure that the agencies charged withprotecting the public are able to respond to unsafe practices rapidly,comprehensively, and conclusively.
